title: Counting the orientations of a finite simple graph
statement: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite vertex set. Then the number of orientations of $G$ is $2^{\abs{E(G)}}$, where $\abs{E(G)}$ denotes the number of edges of $G$; that is, each edge may be directed in either of its two ways, and every such choice yields a distinct orientation.
replaced:
\emph{How many orientations does a simple
graph \texttt{G} have?}
